## Namespace With A Literal RHS [error]

```r
# TODO: tree-sitter-r currently allows an `optional()` RHS, but our grammar
# requires a RHS, so we get `missing (required)`. These should eventually be
# parse errors if we can switch tree-sitter-r away from using `optional()`.
# For example, `a::1` gives:

#> RNamespaceExpression {
#>     left: RIdentifier {
#>         name_token: IDENT@0..6 "a" [Newline("\n"), Whitespace("    ")] [],
#>     },
#>     operator: COLON2@6..8 "::" [] [],
#>     right: missing (required),
#> },
#> RDoubleValue {
#>     value_token: R_DOUBLE_LITERAL@8..9 "1" [] [],
#> },

a::1
a::NA
a::NULL
a::TRUE
a::(b)
a::{ b }

a:::1
a:::NA
a:::NULL
a:::TRUE
a:::(b)
a:::{ b }
```

```cst

    bom_token: missing (optional),
    statements: RStatementList [
        RStatement {

    2 │

  i `:::` requires a name on the left.

  > 1 │ a():::b
      │    ^^^
    2 │
```

## Namespace Newline Is Significant Only Outside Parens

```r
f(stats::
  median)
```

```cst
RRoot {
    bom_token: missing (optional),
    statements: RStatementList [
        RStatement {
            expression: RCall {
                function: RIdentifier {
                    name_token: IDENT@0..1 "f" [] [],
                },
                arguments: RCallArguments {
                    l_paren_token: L_PAREN@1..2 "(" [] [],
                    items: RArgumentList [
                        RArgument {
                            name_clause: missing (optional),
                            value: RNamespaceExpression {
                                left: RIdentifier {
                                    name_token: IDENT@2..7 "stats" [] [],
                                },
                                operator: COLON2@7..9 "::" [] [],
                                right: RIdentifier {
                                    name_token: IDENT@9..18 "median" [Newline("\n"), Whitespace("  ")] [],
                                },
                            },
                        },
                    ],
                    r_paren_token: R_PAREN@18..19 ")" [] [],
                },
            },
            semicolon_token: missing (optional),
        },
    ],
    eof_token: EOF@19..20 "" [Newline("\n")] [],
}
```
